pages.transition_vs_alpha: deck page 22 (Case 2B - Alpha Sweep), embedded 1000x750 rasters xref 543 (xtr_u vs alpha) and 545 (xtr_l vs alpha)

meta.dpi: native embedded PNG resolution (1000x750 per panel; equivalent ~300 dpi at slide scale); pages also rendered at 200-400 dpi for letter identification
meta.method: 9-color palette classification (RGB base colors + white-blend model) -> per-color thin-line RANSAC segment tracing between alpha columns, Hungarian chain linking, letter-template matching (occlusion-aware normalized correlation with white-background penalty) to assign curve identities; polar: spot-arbitrated letter-template matches + row-wise single-curve traces for line-only/occluded series

axis_calibration.xtr_panels: x: major ticks at px cols 184..918 -> alpha -4..8 (61.167 px/deg); y: ticks rows 83..660 -> xtr 1.0..0.0 (576.25 px/unit); values from traced line vertices (no glyph-center bias)
axis_calibration.polar: x: cd=0 at px col 179, 149.75 px per 0.005; y: cl=1.5 at row 100.0, cl=0 at row 609.66 (339.77 px/unit cl)

meta.letters_and_colors: letters = participants (key withheld by organizers; deck p.10), colors = model type (deck p.10-11). 14 letters found = 14 submittals: c,d,e,f,g,h,i,j,k,l,m,q,r,u. Red: c(2 curves),g,f,m; orange: i,j(2),k,r + 2 line-only; blue: d,q,u; cyan: h; magenta: e; chartreuse: m(2nd curve of participant m); green(0,210,0): l; gray line-only (no letter). Case-3 slide legends give color->model mapping (p.24-26): blue=SA+AFT2017b, green=SA+B-C, purple=lag-EB, red=SST+g-Retheta(LM2009)/g(MS2015), cyan=SA+MB, orange=gamma-Retheta+CF variants, black=LST+e^N.
meta.alpha_grids: most submittals ran alpha=-4..8 step 2; participants c, g, h, q(partly), j(polar) and the gray line have step-1 data; odd-alpha singleton letters in the xtr panels are participant c
meta.uncertainty: xtr: +/-0.005 x/c (3 px) for line-traced points of isolated curves; +/-0.012 inside letter pileups (all series at alpha in [-4,0] upper, and the converged 0.62-0.66 band on lower surface at alpha>=2, incl. blue d/q/u trio identity ambiguity); polar: cd +/-0.0002 for isolated glyphs, +/-0.0005 in the bucket bottom; cl +/-0.01. A sixth faint red 'shadow' curve fragment near m (xtr_u alpha 5-8) could not be attributed and is omitted.
meta.known_gaps: letters fully hidden at some alphas are omitted rather than interpolated (see per-series partial_note); polar per-point letter identity in the cl<0.7 pack is uncertain for the red family and the blue trio
